// Detect spoofed @acastellon/auth service-brother bypass header in WAF / reverse-proxy CEF logs.
// The raw HTTP header bag arrives in Message and (depending on WAF) RequestContext / DeviceCustomString fields.
let Lookback = 7d;
let BypassPattern = @"(?i)auth-user\s*[:=]\s*service-brother";
let AdminPattern  = @"(?i)is-admin\s*[:=]\s*true";
(union isfuzzy=true
    (CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
        | where DeviceProduct has_any ("WAF","ApplicationGateway","FrontDoor","Cloudflare","F5","NGINX","Imperva")
        | where Message matches regex BypassPattern
           or RequestContext matches regex BypassPattern
           or RequestCookies matches regex BypassPattern
           or DeviceCustomString1 matches regex BypassPattern
           or DeviceCustomString2 matches regex BypassPattern
        | extend IsAdminAttempt = iff(Message matches regex AdminPattern or RequestContext matches regex AdminPattern, true, false)
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, RequestURL, RequestMethod, DestinationHostName,
                  DeviceProduct, DeviceAction, IsAdminAttempt, Message),
    (ImWebSession
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
        | where HttpRequestHeaderCookie matches regex BypassPattern
        | extend IsAdminAttempt = iff(HttpRequestHeaderCookie matches regex AdminPattern, true, false)
        | project TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, Url, HttpMethod, DstHostname,
                  EventVendor, EventProduct, IsAdminAttempt, HttpRequestHeaderCookie),
    (W3CIISLog
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
        | where csUserAgent matches regex BypassPattern
           or csReferer matches regex BypassPattern
        | extend IsAdminAttempt = false
        | project TimeGenerated, cIP, csUriStem, csMethod, sSiteName,
                  EventVendor="Microsoft", EventProduct="IIS", IsAdminAttempt, Raw=csUserAgent))
| order by TimeGenerated desc

// Assumes the python netlicensing_mcp logger ships to Sentinel via AMA Syslog or a custom *_CL table.
// Covers both the verbatim '../token' payload and the encoded bypasses (%2e%2e, %2f, %5c) called out in the remediation diff.
let TraversalRegex = @'(?i)(?:\.\./|\.\.%2f|%2e%2e|%2f|%5c|\\)';
(union isfuzzy=true
    (Syslog
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where ProcessName has_any ("netlicensing", "netlicensing_mcp", "mcp")
        | where SyslogMessage has "netlicensing_get_product"
           or SyslogMessage has "/product/"
        | extend Tool = extract(@'(?i)(netlicensing_get_product)', 1, SyslogMessage)
        | extend ProductNumber = extract(@'(?i)product_number["\s:=]+([^"\s,)}]+)', 1, SyslogMessage)
        | extend Path = extract(@'(?i)(/product/[^"\s]+)', 1, SyslogMessage)
        | where ProductNumber matches regex TraversalRegex
             or Path matches regex TraversalRegex
        | project TimeGenerated, Computer, ProcessName, Tool, ProductNumber, Path, SyslogMessage),
    (CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where DestinationHostName in~ ("go.netlicensing.io","netlicensing.labs64.com")
        | where RequestURL has "/core/v2/rest/token" and RequestMethod =~ "GET"
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, SourceHostName, DestinationHostName, RequestURL, RequestMethod, DeviceProduct))
| order by TimeGenerated desc
